accuracy.reason: RFC-backed reuse, Age and validation rules are qualified by layer and policy; private storage, authenticated reuse, purge reach and stale windows avoid false guarantees. Diagrams distinguish hits from origin validation.

evidence.quote: 304 saves retransmitting the body across the validation hop.

mechanisms.reason: Cards trace both cache layers, age arithmetic, conditional request and body/metadata transitions, variant matching, URL version change, purge limits and bounded error reuse. Learner applies the actual steps.

evidence.quote: Receiving it does not start a new full lifetime.

coherence.reason: Layer ownership precedes freshness and validation, which precede privacy and key matching; updates and stale reuse build on those rules before workload economics. Examples clarify independent distinctions without requiring one story.

evidence.quote: Identify the cache layer before saying which work a hit avoids.

decisions.reason: Each choice is bounded: public versus private policy, meaningful key distinctions versus fragmentation, immutable versus mutable updates, stale tolerance and measured CDN benefit/cost. Card 8 explicitly permits omitting shared caching.

evidence.quote: Keep privacy rules intact rather than making private content shared to improve a metric.

clarity.reason: HTTP-specific terms and directives are defined before application. Timelines and 304 branches expose easy misconceptions; detail maps to required objectives rather than unrelated trivia.

evidence.quote: no-cache means validate; no-store means do not store; private excludes shared caches.

outcomes.reason: C1-C8: learner defines response caches and origin, traces miss/return plus both hits and storage policy, distinguishes database records, calculates 80% and 200 under assumptions, excludes browser/byte/real-work inference, and balances public reuse gains against CDN/operating cost and private low-reuse omission; cards 1,8 teach all.

C1-C8: learner defines policies/fresh/stale/Age, computes browser 30 seconds expired and CDN 210 left without reset or origin-freshness promise, explains representation/opaque tag and conditional GET, 304 retained body/metadata versus 200 replacement, and remaining origin/database work; cards 2-3 teach each step.

C1-C6: learner defines cookie/credential/identity/permission roles, chooses no-cache/private/no-store correctly with their limits, denies automatic cookie partition/bypass, describes cross-user leakage and verifies origin authorization plus effective shared exclusion; card 4 supplies all.

C1-C5: learner defines key/variants, preserves format query and language under actual CDN configuration, explains Vary matching and bypass if unsupported, contrasts wrong content with irrelevant-key fragmentation and retains privacy rules; card 5 directly teaches all.

C1-C4: learner versions changed bytes and referring page while recognizing old pages, chooses mutable freshness/revalidation, rejects automatic database invalidation, checks purge URL/variant/layer/completion and denies recall of browser/downloaded copies; card 6 supports all.

C1-C5: learner distinguishes optional background validation from error fallback, calculates 15 seconds stale at 75, 90 at 150 and 140 at 200 against windows ending 90/180, requires eligible copy/support and respects cold-cache/privacy/urgent-removal limits; card 7 teaches all.

sourceChecks.claim: Live Cloudflare CDN guide and RFC9111 distinguish shared/private response caching and origin. Diagram accurately routes misses/returns and scopes work avoided at each layer.

Live MDN Cache-Control and primary RFC9111 confirm existing Age subtraction, shared s-maxage precedence and policy-based freshness. Arithmetic 90-60=30 expired and 300-90=210 fresh checked; delivery does not reset age.

Live MDN ETag and primary RFC9111 validation sections confirm If-None-Match, 304 metadata update plus retained body and full replacement response. Both branches contact origin; no database-work guarantee is implied.

Live RFC9111 confirms unqualified no-cache validation, private shared-storage exclusion, no-store prohibition/limits, Set-Cookie not inherently inhibiting caching and conditional Authorization reuse. Origin permissions remain separate.

Live Cloudflare cache-key documentation permits explicit query/header inclusion and exclusion; RFC9111 Vary matching preserves nominated header distinctions. Lesson correctly requires verifying CDN support rather than assuming default Accept-Language handling.

Live Cloudflare purge docs expose URL/tag/key scope and warn successful purge response alone does not prove eviction. Linked browser-TTL guidance separates browser copies; versioned URLs and policy-bounded mutable reuse do not promise recall.

Live RFC5861 defines stale windows after freshness expiry and optional supported reuse. Checked max-age 60 plus 30 ends at 90, plus 120 ends at 180; age 200 exceeds both. No copy/support means no fallback guarantee.

Live Cloudflare hit-ratio guide defines hits over hits plus misses. Specified layer and one-origin-call assumptions yield 80% and 200; bytes, browser hits and database work are distinct. CDN economics are conditional rather than guaranteed savings.
